# Fox Kids Dentistry & Orthodontics

> > A dual-specialty pediatric dental and orthodontic practice in downtown Portland, Oregon led by Dr. Paul and Dr. Dana Fox, offering comprehensive care for infants, children, and teens.

Fox Kids Dentistry combines pediatric dentistry and orthodontics under one roof in Portland, OR. The practice is staffed by board-certified specialists and emphasizes preventive care, patient education, and creating a welcoming environment for young patients.
